# DenchCo Knowledge Base Wiki Standard

> An OKF-compatible, evidence-governed standard for coordinated Human and LLM Wikis. This discovery file and its Markdown alternates are derived navigation aids; released repository specifications, schemas, profiles, and registered evidence retain authority.

This path-scoped llms.txt follows the August 2026 v2 proposal. View or search this overview, then follow only the relevant Markdown links. HTML pages advertise their Markdown alternate and this discovery file. Links resolve beneath the Wiki's current path, including its GitHub Pages project path. An Optional section is a reading convention, not a processing directive.

For repository work, read AGENTS.md, .wiki-standard.yaml, the specification, LLM entry point, and project status. Preserve unknown OKF fields and deviations. Use Graphify query-first with scoped-source fallback. Ask material clarifications one at a time. Complete the requested scope; retain at most three unfinished, goal-linked next actions and respect parked-work triggers. Reader navigation in development responses uses the configured, verified live canonical Wiki origin.

For a new independent Wiki, the normative repository URL is the bootstrap invocation. Follow its prompts/instantiate-wiki.md adaptive discovery and create subject-owned evidence; do not copy the Standard's knowledge corpus. The optional Codex plugin does not confer normative authority or automatically enable hooks.

## Canonical entry points

- [Specification](spec/index.md): Normative scope and authority.
- [Requirements](spec/requirements/index.md): Stable requirement IDs and verification contracts.
- [Profiles](spec/profiles/index.md): Selected profile obligations.
- [LLM Wiki](llm-wiki/index.md): Repository read order and maintenance contract.
- [Context map](llm-wiki/context-map/index.md): Smallest useful canonical reading set.
- [Architecture](architecture/index.md): Human and LLM product boundaries.
- [Sources](sources/index.md): Registered upstream identities and evidence authority.

## Workflows and verification

- [Conformance evidence](conformance/index.md): Verification and dogfood evidence.
- [Standard proposals](llm-wiki/standard-proposals/index.md): Consumer provenance, governed intake, release inclusion, and adoption boundaries.
- [Codex adapter](llm-wiki/codex-adapter/index.md): Optional local trust and Stop-hook limits.
- [Web discovery](llm-wiki/web-discovery/index.md): Markdown alternates and path-scoped discovery.
- [Validation queue](validation-queue/index.md): Open and parked evidence work.
- [Project status](project/status/index.md): Current bounded priorities.

## Optional

- [Public normative repository](https://github.com/denchco/knowledge-base-wiki-standard): Immutable revisions, schemas, CLI, starter, and plugin source; repository pages are a code-discovery exception to the Markdown preference.
- [Human documentation](https://denchco.github.io/knowledge-base-wiki-documentation/): Published reader entry point; use its describedby link to discover the current Markdown view.
